cloudAutoImport.title: Add this game to Cloud Archive?
cloudAutoImport.description: Vnite will move the files for {{gameName}} into the local cache directory and generate cloud 7z volumes. The original import location will not be deleted. Large games can take a while and use local cache and cloud archive space.

notifications.success: {{gameName}} has been added to Cloud Archive. The local cache is playable and the cloud archive is ready.
notifications.failed: Failed to add {{gameName}} to Cloud Archive: {{message}}. The game was imported normally and can be retried later.
notifications.skipped: Imported normally. You can add it to Cloud Archive later from the context menu or Cloud Archive page.

errors.spaceInsufficient: Local cache space is not enough, so Cloud Archive import was skipped. The game was imported normally; clear space and add it to Cloud Archive manually later.
errors.sevenZipUnavailable: No usable 7-Zip was found, so the cloud archive could not be generated. The game was imported normally; install 7-Zip or set a 7z path in Cloud Archive settings and retry later.
errors.cloudConfigInvalid: Cloud Archive directory validation failed, so automatic Cloud Archive import was canceled. The game remains normally imported; check Cloud Archive settings and retry manually later.
errors.taskCanceled: Automatic Cloud Archive import was canceled. The game was imported normally and can be retried later.
